scope: New deterministic mock entry filter and context evidence; not a trained or calibrated model
window: 21 consecutive closed UTC15m candles; prior range20 excludes last signal candle
directionalEfficiency: abs(lastClose-firstClose)/sum(abs(successive close changes)); 0 for a fully flat valid path, unknown for missing/invalid evidence
entryHypothesis: Reject new trend-continuation entries when efficiency<=0.2, signal high breaches prior range but closes back within it, signal sweeps both sides, or closes below prior support. Protective and existing held bearish exits remain independent.
knownHistory: Existing 90day history/previous ridge test windows already inspected; subsequent historical comparisons retrospective, no independent validation claim.
frozenComparison: Running corrected experiment retains source5cad/Mockv1 without this new filter; never patch it in place.
validation: Analytic positive/negative/causality/data-gap tests first, then fixed historical comparison with unchanged costs/universe; no profit claim from fewer trades.
upstreamFinding: Pinned Jesse er.py uses nth finite differences and one total sum; do not port blindly. Own explicit rolling formula and source-quality guards; no foreign code reused.
